description: This file defines a RedisQueueListener class that inherits from BackgroundService, designed to listen for messages on a Redis list ('notifications:queue') and broadcast these messages to WebSocket clients via WebSocketConnectionManager. It manages Redis connection, logs activity, and handles exceptions during message retrieval.

classes.name: RedisQueueListener
classes.description: A background service that listens to a Redis list for new messages and broadcasts them to connected WebSocket clients.

methods.name: RedisQueueListener
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the RedisQueueListener with dependencies such as logger, WebSocket manager, and Redis connection.

methods.name: ExecuteAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method that continuously listens for new messages on Redis list and broadcasts them; handles reconnection and error conditions.
